author: claude
description: Pier(length=24, depth=6, ...) is a 5-wide spruce boardwalk on log pilings running toward +Z with fence rails and lantern posts, ending in a 15-wide T-head with a FishingHut (7x8x7 gable-roofed hut with smoker, fish barrel, gear chest), bench and barrels; size [15, depth+9, length], deck at local y=depth, entry at z=0. Sailboat(hull, deck, keel, sail, mast) is a 5x12x12 block boat (waterline local y=0) with a triangular sail and pennant. build(length, depth, boats=True) adds two moored boats (27 wide); ground_level=depth+1 so the placement y is the deck walking plane (deck = water surface + 1). Entry 'boat'(style 0-3) places a single sailboat with y = water surface + 1. Rotate CLOCKWISE_90 to run the pier west.
name: harbour_pier
title: Harbour pier, fishing hut and sailboats
